newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-CROATS BOBAN AND BOKSIC GIVEN ONE-MATCH BANS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CROATS BOBAN AND BOKSIC GIVEN ONE-MATCH BANS.

text.p: Zvonimir Boban and striker Alen Boksic, who helped Croatia to a 4-1 win over Bosnia in a World Cup qualifier on Tuesday, were brought down to earth on Wednesday with one-match Italian league bans.
Italy's sporting judge confirmed a ban on Juventus goalscorer Boksic, who hit the target twice on Tuesday, for "incorrect behaviour towards an opponent".
Boksic, hitting top form at European Cup holders Juventus after a poor three seasons at Lazio, was sent off during a serie A match at home to Fiorentina on September 29 for a second bookable offence.
Milan's Boban was sent off the same day for committing two fouls against Perugia.
